name: Ascetics Cap

source.name: Ascetics Cap
source.description: +25% magical resistance. A non-Undead carrier has a chance to be reborn into an undead piece of the same rank and level.

descriptions.en: +25% magical resistance. A non-Undead carrier has a chance to be reborn into an undead piece of the same rank and level.
descriptions.ru: +25% маг.резиста. Носитель не-Undead имеет шанс переродиться в фигуру Undead с тем же рангом и уровнем.
descriptions.zh-cn: 魔法抗性+25%，非亡灵携带者获得效果：回合开始时有概率被转化为一个同等级同星的随机亡灵棋子。
descriptions.zh-tw: 魔法抗性+25%，非亡靈攜帶者獲得效果：回合開始時有概率被轉化爲一個同等級同星的隨機亡靈棋子。

lore_i18n.zh-cn: 一顶朴素的帽子，看上去源自幽幽城。
lore_i18n.zh-tw: 一頂樸素的帽子，看上去源自幽幽城。

notes: At most 1 undead piece can resurrect each round.
IO cannot resurrect. Independent with Dismiss.

commentary:
The transformation chance depends on the carrier's base shop cost.

| Carrier cost | Script threshold |
|---:|---:|
| 1 | 90% |
| 2 | 80% |
| 3 | 70% |
| 4 | 60% |
| 5 | 50% |

On success, the carrier is replaced by a random Undead piece of the same cost and star level. At most one piece can transform per round.

A 3-star Druid is treated as costing 1 less for both the roll and the resulting Undead, i.e. a 3-star 1-cost Druid is treated as 0-cost and cannot transform.
